isolation: Temporary review server and browser tab; primary app port and its stored user data were not used.
method: Real browser interactions against the final local implementation; public card data resolved through the existing import and search paths.

checks.name: First import
checks.evidence: 100 cards in six entries; Othelm, Sigardian Outcast, Lymph Sliver, Virulent Sliver, Counterspell, The Soul Stone and Forest resolved. Existing WG color-identity warnings remained.

checks.name: Absorb detection and rule reference
checks.evidence: Lymph Sliver appeared under Absorb; exact source slice absorb 1 at oracle_text offset 26; numbered CR 702.64a, b and c displayed.

checks.name: Poisonous search
checks.evidence: Manual Commander WG search returned Virulent Sliver; the outside-identity black card was excluded.

checks.name: Printing and Clipboard preservation
checks.evidence: Inspected SLD 659Φ discovery printing, saved one copy, observed Save another copy and 1 copy in Clipboard while the dialog remained open. Imported TSR 246 printing remained unchanged. Escape closed the dialog and restored focus to Inspect discovery card.

checks.name: Friends forever reference
checks.evidence: Friends forever and Partner remained separate labels; Friends forever displayed the current CR 702.124i clause.

checks.name: Second import
checks.evidence: 100 cards in five entries; Othelm, Sigardian Outcast, Seven of Nine, Borg Queen, Perfection Manifest, Etali, Primal Garden and Forest resolved. Actualize, Assimilate and Face a dilemma appeared.

checks.name: Unverified official definition stays explicit
checks.evidence: Actualize showed CARD LABEL · OFFICIAL SOURCE UNVERIFIED and a Scryfall card example link to Etali, Primal Garden. No general official definition was supplied.

checks.name: Zero results do not widen the search
checks.evidence: Manual Actualize search retained Commander WG restrictions and returned No compatible Actualize cards found; the imported exclusion was explained.

checks.name: Published Star Trek reference
checks.evidence: Face a dilemma showed Seven of Nine and an expanded Wizards reference linking Collecting Magic: The Gathering® | Star Trek™: A First Look, section The Mechanics of Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek.

checks.name: Browser console
checks.evidence: Final query for warning/error messages returned an empty array.

limits: Browser checks are representative interaction checks. All 42 detection/search cases, 373-name reconciliation, all 32 commander-color subsets and source integrity are covered separately by retained automated verification; this is not a claim that every interaction or future card was manually tested.
